title: workplan_reset input (native surface)
description: Reset a plan's statuses to draft (keeping its content), wipe its phases/findings/notes after a preview and confirmation (archiving the originals), or regenerate only its Markdown. Pass expectedHash = the stateHash from your latest read or successful write.

id.description: Workplan id; normalized to lowercase [a-z0-9-] (max 80) before use.

mode.description: Operation mode. draft (D.3): status-only reset; the plan, every phase and every step go back to draft and the checkpoint sidecar is removed; phases, steps, notes, findings, scope, constraints and the dependency graph are kept. wipe (D.3): clears phases, findings and (unless preserveNotes) notes after a preview and an exact previewToken + confirmation, archiving the complete originals first and removing the checkpoint and dependency sidecars. markdown-only: regenerates only the linked Markdown.

preserveNotes.description: Keep notes on a wipe (D.3: a draft reset always keeps notes).

expectedHash.description: stateHash from the latest read; binds the write to that exact state.

previewToken.description: D.3, mode=wipe only: the previewToken of the wipe preview (a call without previewToken and confirmation). Binds the state, the removed content, preserveNotes and the Markdown treatment; it is not authority.

confirmation.description: D.3, mode=wipe only: must be WIPE_PLAN_CONTENT to apply the wipe.

x-shiori-rules.native: Native existing-state writes require the current stateHash — pass expectedHash set to the stateHash from your last successful write, or re-read with workplan_resume or workplan_inspect first

x-shiori-rules.when: previewToken or confirmation present and mode is not wipe (D.3)
x-shiori-rules.native: previewToken and confirmation apply only to mode=wipe
x-shiori-rules.core: previewToken and confirmation apply only to mode=wipe

x-shiori-rules.when: mode is wipe and previewToken or confirmation is present (D.3 apply)
mode is wipe and confirmation is present without previewToken (D.3 apply)
x-shiori-rules.native: Wipe apply requires the previewToken from a workplan_reset mode=wipe preview (call it without previewToken and confirmation first)
x-shiori-rules.core: Wipe apply requires the previewToken from a workplan_reset mode=wipe preview (call it without previewToken and confirmation first)

x-shiori-core-surface: The standalone CLI/core surface additionally accepts optional 'workspaceRoot' (string); the native surface rejects it as an unrecognized key. The allOf conditions are native-surface rules; the core surface keeps expectedHash optional for legacy direct calls (a concurrent change must still be detected), and uses the 'core' messages in x-shiori-rules.
